name: Iori
message: 「Excuse me, is Sasaki-sensei in？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, I’m here. What do you need？」
A listless voice came from the back of the infirmary. Thank goodness, having Sasaki-sensei here was reassuring.

name: Iori
message: 「Two students have collapsed. Could you please examine them?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, uuu……」

name: Momiji
message: 「I feel so sick……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Kazamine Setsugekka and… oh, Momiji is here too today? What on earth happened?」
Her expression changed the moment she saw Setsugekka and Momiji. I briefly explained the situation.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Understood. Could you lay them both on the beds?」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「M-mughh……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Breathing and pulse are stable… Next, let’s see about Momiji. Hmm, no particular issues here, either.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thank goodness……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah~~… I feel sick, I’m going to throw up……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「They should recover if they just rest for a while.」
I let out a sigh of relief upon hearing Sasaki-sensei’s assessment. It’s been a long time since I’ve felt this tense.

name: Mikoto
message: 「So？ What exactly is going on？」

name: Iori
message: 「I don’t know the details myself. Setsugekka and Shizuku-san were having a match, then suddenly……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「……Shizuku？ You don’t mean Minamoto Shizuku, do you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, that’s her.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I see. That would explain their symptoms.」
Sasaki-sensei clutched her head as soon as she heard Shizuku-san’s name. What on earth does that mean？

name: Iori
message: 「What’s the problem with it being Shizuku-san？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Listen, Minamoto Shizuku’s ancestor is none other than Minamoto no Yorimitsu.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「And she possesses the atavistic special Tenju, ‘<d0080>Demon Extermination</d>’.」

name: Iori
message: 「Demon Extermination…… don’t tell me……」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Exactly, it’s that power of warding off evil everyone talks about. That stuff is seriously dangerous. Any ordinary Keyou would be blown to smithereens just by touching it.」

name: Iori
message: 「B-blown to smithereens, you say… that’s terrifying.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I don’t know if Setsugekka is a Saniwa or what, but it seems she’s keeping a Keyou inside her.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That’s likely what reacted to the Demon Extermination.」

name: Iori
message: 「I believe what’s inside her is a Mizuchi—a dragon god or a snake god.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hmm, I don't know who or what it is, but its status seems surprisingly high. Otherwise, it would have been wiped out without a trace by now.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「It seems weakened right now, but it should recover soon.」

name: Iori
message: 「O-oh, I see… that’s a relief.」
If the god inside Setsugekka were to vanish, her dreams would be cut short.

name: Iori
message: 「But if that’s the case, why would it affect Momiji…」

name: Mikoto
message: 「What, you didn’t know？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「The Suzakuin Family has the blood of a Keyou mixed into their ancestry. In other words, Momiji is a <d0089>Hanyou</d> with very diluted blood.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, that rumor was actually true！？」
Isn't there Keyou blood mixed into the Suzakuin Family.
That was one of the rumors whispered plausibly about the overwhelming strength of the Suzakuin Family.

name: Mikoto
message: 「That said, it was a long time ago—over 400 years ago. The amount of Keyou blood in Momiji is only a tiny fraction.」

name: Iori
message: 「So you mean that blood reacted to the Demon Extermination?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, that’s about it.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Momiji is also out of commission from being hit by the Demon Extermination, but she’ll recover soon, so don’t worry.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s good… Thank you very much, Doctor.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Don't mention it. I am a doctor, after all.」
I breathed a sigh of relief and bowed my head.

name: Iori
message: 「By the way, I’d like to ask one thing.」

name: Iori
message: 「If these two end up facing Shizuku at the Martial Festival… what should they do?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, not fighting is the best option.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「But then again, I know they can’t just easily withdraw from such a big stage.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Indeed... as I said before, the power of Anti-Evil is immense. If they were to remain exposed to its influence...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Kazamine would lose his divine spirit of the secret place and cease to be a Saniwa. If that happens, he’d likely be finished as a swordsman.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「In Momiji’s case, her Mental Resonance Coefficient relies heavily on her bloodline. There’s a risk of severe repercussions.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That said, in the end, no one can truly predict what kind of effects will manifest. We have no choice but to try.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「As long as you have your Barrier Jacket, you won’t be cut down. No matter what happens, at the very worst, you won’t die.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「However, the agony caused by Demon Extermination is beyond imagination. It’s not something you can just endure easily.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, if you think things are getting dangerous, you be the one to stop them.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「*Sigh*... To think there’s such a troublesome character around. That Anti-Evil power is nothing but a nuisance.」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you not fond of the power of Anti-Evil either, Miss Sasaki？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「W-what are you talking about？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, it’s just that you seem to really dislike it...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I-it’s not that I’m ‘not fond’ of it, it’s just... well. Demon Extermination is incredibly potent and frightening, after all.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「To a Hanyou, that thing is the equivalent of a walking time bomb. I’d rather not get near Minamoto Shizuku as much as possible.」
...That sounds exactly like Miss Sasaki’s own personal experience.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you actually a Keyou, Miss Sasaki?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「D-don’t be ridiculous! Do you really think a Keyou can be this human-like?!」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, now that you mention it, that’s true.」
She looks normal enough, and her mannerisms are truly human.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Anyway, these two don’t have symptoms that are anything serious. Once they wake up, hurry up and take them home!」
With that, Miss Sasaki walked off somewhere.
